title: Aorist passive: -θη-
subtitle: Recognize a key passive signal without oversimplifying it.
overview: Many aorist passive forms show -θη-: ἐλύθην, ἐσώθη. The ending identifies the person and number.
Some -θη- forms have intransitive or middle-like force in context, so start with the form and read the clause.

items.en: They were baptized in the Jordan.
